cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC INVESTIGATES ROGUE ACCESS TO HACK-ENABLING AI

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic's Mythos model accessed by unauthorised users: Bloomberg
cluster_stories.summary: Unauthorized users reportedly gained access to Anthropic's new Mythos AI model via a private online forum on the same day the company announced plans for limited testing. Anthropic is investigating the alleged breach through a third-party vendor environment. The powerful AI, intended for defensive cybersecurity, has raised regulatory concerns due to its vulnerability detection capabilities.
cluster_stories.headline: UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS HITS ANTHROPIC'S MYTHOS MODEL

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic’s Mythos Accessed by Unauthorized Users
cluster_stories.summary: A small group of unauthorized users have accessed Anthropic's new Mythos AI model, a technology that the company says is so powerful it can enable dangerous cyberattacks, according to a person familiar with the matter and documentation viewed by Bloomberg News. Bloomberg Intelligence's Matt Bloxham explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
